# HomeOne

> > HomeOne is a directory platform connecting Australian homeowners with local home improvement and financial services across Sydney, Melbourne, and Perth.

HomeOne provides curated listings for home building, kitchen design, decking installation, and mortgage brokerage services. The platform features verified local businesses including DIY Australia, Brite Decking, BP Building Concepts, First Choice Mortgage Brokers, and AGL across major Australian cities.
